featured_reviews.name: Kushal Raut
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited The Urban Juice Café again today with a friend 👫 — and as always, it was a pleasant and tasty experience! 😋✨
This wasn’t my first time — I’ve been here 3-4 times before, including once for my birthday celebration 🎉🎂

It’s a great spot for:
🍔 Snacks & quick bites
🥤 Shakes & beverages
🍕 Pizzas
🍝 Pastas and more!

Today we tried:
🍫 Belgium Dark Chocolate Shake — super rich & satisfying
🍄 Mushroom Alfredo Spaghetti — creamy and well-made

Previously I’ve had:
❤️ Red Velvet Shake,
🍕 Pizza, and
🍝 Pasta — all were consistently delicious.

One thing I truly appreciate is — they never compromise on taste ✅👌
Every dish feels freshly made with quality ingredients.

💸 Yes, prices are a bit on the higher side — but it’s justified by the:
🎶 Good Ambience
🌬️ AC environment
🍽️ Nice presentation
🎵 Soft background music — makes it a great chill spot with friends.

🔧 One suggestion: They should work on improving their sitting tables — a little upgrade in comfort and space would enhance the overall vibe.

📍A good café to sit, relax, chat, and enjoy tasty bites 🍴

Rating: 4 out of 5 stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Will definitely visit again!

Their fresh juices are incredibly refreshing, and you can really taste the quality of the fruits. The soups are light yet flavorful—perfect if you want something healthy and comforting. But the real highlight for me was the aamras 😍—rich, naturally sweet, and absolutely delicious, just like homemade!

The place is clean, the service is quick, and everything feels fresh and hygienic. Definitely a great spot if you're looking for healthy and tasty options. Highly recommend trying their aamras and fresh juices! 👍 Must Visit Place👍
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hello Deep Sir,

Thank you for such a detailed and wonderful review. We’re really glad you had an amazing experience and enjoyed our fresh juices, soups, and especially the Aamras. It’s great to know you found it rich, natural, and close to homemade—that’s exactly what we aim for at our juice center.

We focus on serving freshly made juice and food prepared daily with zero added sugar, no preservatives, no added colour, and no artificial flavours, while maintaining hygiene and quick service.
Your recommendation truly means a lot to us. We look forward to welcoming you again soon.

Warm regards,
Team The Juice Farm

featured_reviews.name: Krisha Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: It was best experience ...staff was too polite and their juices are best ....I have visited it for 3-4 times ....and I am really big fan of their juices ...i guess everyone should try once ....!!!!😊
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Krisha,

We’re truly grateful for your continued support and are delighted to know that you’ve visited The Juice Farm multiple times. Hearing that you’re a fan of our juices and appreciate our team’s polite service means a lot to us. We always strive to serve freshly made juice with natural taste, quality ingredients, and a welcoming experience for every customer.

Thank you for your wonderful recommendation. We look forward to welcoming you back for many more refreshing visits.

Warm regards,
Team The Juice Farm

featured_reviews.name: Steven Fargose
featured_reviews.review_text: Wasn’t aware of this place until my wife informed me about the fruit cream they offer. Have become a big fan ever since i tried the mango cream. There are very few places where u try something and Woww!! Is how you describe it. You wont see anyone on instagram promoting this place as its a gem.All the juices are a must try. There is also a snacks shop besides this place which serve awesome sandwiches. Combine them and this is the evening go to place with friends and family for snacking. Opposite this place is Kubera where you can wrap up the day with pav bhaji.

featured_reviews.name: Rashmi Pillai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Must Try ...Awesome varieties of juices. And they’re 100% natural. You can see them make it and transfer in your glass infront of you. Hygienic and Presentation wise great.
Have tried Mango , Mausambi juice here.They add tiny bits of the fruit too in the juice from above and it’s yummy.Fresh juice sold the moment you ask for it. Value for money as the quality and quantity is good.Amazing fresh juices and milkshakes and wide variety.

featured_reviews.name: mayuri patwardhan
featured_reviews.review_text: Fresh & flavoured juices. Various types of juices are served here. Avacado milkshake and dragon fruit & kiwi are the two all time favourite juices which one must try. Apart from that various other juices like sweet lime, orange, pomegranate, carrot, beetroot,etc., are also served here. Hardly any place to sit here. Take aways are allowed. Just a small shop where you can stand out and drink.

featured_reviews.name: Elon Reeve Musk
featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing place for fresh fruit juices and milkshakes! It’s a well known place in Vasai from ages.  Order is served almost instantly and the process is very hygienic as well.  Must visit place for fruit lovers, highly recommended.

featured_reviews.review_text: Fresh and natural fruit juices. Seasonal fruits are good to have here.

featured_reviews.name: Nisarg
featured_reviews.review_text: Very costly. Its a little juice centre. Nothing fancy. Some plastic chairs placed outside thus no proper sitting. Juice quality was fine but quantity was just routine. Doesnt justify the price at all for a simple juice centre in Vasai area. How can prices be more than Mumbai?

featured_reviews.name: Janhavi Raut
featured_reviews.review_text: UJC has a great variety of juices and healthy options. I tried their Citrus Ginger Cure, which was really refreshing and perfectly balanced. My friend ordered a Cocktail Juice, which was just okay. We also tried the Avocado Toast — it had a strong flavour of jalapeño, but overall, the taste was good. Nice place for health-conscious food and drinks!

featured_reviews.name: Ramvriksh kumar Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a truly fantastic experience at this cafe, which is an absolutely mast (amazing) spot with a great vibe; the food, in particular the pizza, pasta, and sandwich, was delicious and highly enjoyable. What made the visit even better was the exceptional service provided by Amar, one of the staff members, who was attentive and ensured everything was perfect throughout my meal. I highly recommend this cafe for its excellent food and top-notch service!

featured_reviews.name: Kushal Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text: Tasty, light and variety of food. Nice place to spend time and chat with friends. Recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Revati Dalbanjan 15
featured_reviews.review_text: Not a great experience.The AC wasn’t functioning properly, and one of the wall fans was also not working, which made the seating area a bit uncomfortable. The pineapple juice was decent, but the white sauce pasta was quite disappointing. Hoping for improvements.

featured_reviews.name: Shubham Kothari
featured_reviews.review_text:
The place is beautifully designed and has a very positive vibe to it! The sitting is comfortable and cozy.
The service is very quick and the staff is very courteous.
I absolutely loved the Farmers choice pizza and the mushroom overloaded oven baked sandwich.
The Malai kulfi shake is a unique preparation, definitely a must try dish.
The Pine Kiwi juice is refreshing and delicious.

Overall an amazing experience here at UJC. Kudos to the team!

featured_reviews.name: Afridi Sheik
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mushroom pasta ✅ also the Avacado salad was fresh which was a best combo alongside salad dressing 👌

Feedback:- Panini bread are too crisp which can be little soft so the stuffing can be enjoyed. need to work on the grilling or toasting part of the bread.

Must try:- Refreshing juice menu

featured_reviews.name: Ryan Lopes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Urban Juice Cafe is located at 100 ft road in Vasai West.
We visited this place only for dessert and boy oh boy it was delicious!👌
We had the Hot brownie with ice-cream.
Do try it out...

The ambience is amazing.
A place where the menu is printed on the table itself which is something unique.
They have a projector screen which constantly plays YouTube music videos.
Good lighting for a soothing ambience.
Food quality is quite good.

Parking available right outside the cafe, so no need to worry about the parking.

featured_reviews.name: zalak pandya
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited this cute and cozy cafe in Vasai west! The ambience was very nice and attractive! The variety of menu was vast here. Staff was very courteous and helpful.
We had
🔺 Creamy Mushroom Pasta-  Pasta was fully loaded with cheese and was too creamy. The subtle flavour of mushroom added more taste to it! Garlic bread which was accompanied with it was also tasty and crunchy!
🔺 Classic fusion fondue - Hot cheese fondue with french fries, chilli garlic potato nuggets and garlic breadstick. Fondue was lip smacking and had that authentic fondue flavour with cheese
🔺 Strawberry cream - If you are a strawberry lover then this is a gem for you. Fresh strawberries with lots of cream and there was strawberry syrup at the end which was the game changer. It was very yummy!
🔺Chocoberry shake with ice cream - The taste was really good but it would have been  more better if it was abit more chocolaty!
Good place to hang out!
